$comment: Temporary, justified acceptances for govulncheck findings whose vulnerable
code we call. Enforced by scripts/govulncheck-gate.sh — see that script for
An entry is only legitimate when no fixed version exists yet AND the advisory
is provably not exploitable here (or is mitigated in our code). Always prefer
upgrading. Every entry MUST carry a reason and a near-term `expires` date; the
gate fails once that date passes, and once the finding goes away (stale).

advisories.reason: No fixed version (all releases through v0.5.1). Both bugs need an assertion signed by the provider's own IdP. (1) Nil Issuer panic: caught by recoverAssertionPanic in internal/auth/saml.go, so it is a failed login. (2) Foreign-namespace NameID: accounts are keyed by (provider, NameID), and a provider's IdP can already sign any NameID for that provider, so it gains no access it did not have; an outside attacker cannot sign. SAML SSO is Enterprise-only and not configured on our servers. Remove this entry and the recover guard when crewjam ships a fix.
